replaceDescription: The draft takes the place of the subject and description written now.

hooksSkipped.other: Its {hooks} hooks do not run: this folder is not trusted.

notSigned: The commit is not signed: signing runs only in a trusted folder.
subject: Subject
subjectLong: Git advises a subject of at most 50 characters
draftHelp: Draft a message from the staged changes, by function. Made here, without AI.

amendPushed: The last commit is on {remotes}: amending it means pushing with Overwrite.
